title: Design generic focused launcher record provenance compatible with external-project launchers
outcome: Design generic focused launcher record provenance compatible with external-project launchers
acceptance: A reviewed design distinguishes valid generic focused launcher artifacts from copied foreign evidence while accounting for the existing external-project records in focused_stage_line_notice fixtures.
The design states migration, producer changes and required compatibility/negative controls before implementation; no existing provenance requirement is invented without an agreed contract.
